Do these providers sell a hosted compute sandbox or hosted compute capacity? For each, add a record with its price, free tier and identity cost, or record why it is not an offer.
An audit of the first attempt judged these claims unsupported by their sources; settle each one first:
- compute/platinum $.free_tier.stated: Core (starts at USD 0, credit before sandbox, promo adds credit) is supported. But 'the docs refer to trial ... credit' is not on any captured page (billing, llms.txt, auth.md contain no 'trial'); only 'Promo credit' appears. Fresh read of billing page gave the same hash.
- compute/platinum $.identity_cost.kind: Page names Stripe-hosted checkout for credit packs; a card is stated only for auto top-up and tier t2 ('a saved card'). Nothing says a card is required to buy the first credits, so identity kind 'card' is not shown.
